request.style: English, male rock voice, raw and aggressive, distorted electric guitar, heavy bass, pounding drums, organ, dark and intense mood, 120 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Word of the Lord came to me
Judge the city of blood now
Confront her with detestable deeds
Idols made against herself

[Pre-Chorus]
You shed blood and bring guilt
Your days are near the end
Mocked by nations far and near
Princes shed blood with power

[Chorus]
You are dross in the furnace
Melted by my wrath
I will gather you into anger
And blow the fire of fury

[Verse]
Treating father and mother with contempt
Oppressing the stranger in your midst
Wronging the orphan and the widow
Despising what is holy to me

[Pre-Chorus]
Men slander to shed blood
Eating at mountain shrines
Uncleanness in your midst
You have forgotten me

[Chorus]
You are dross in the furnace
Melted by my wrath
I will gather you into anger
And blow the fire of fury

[Bridge]
Prophets like roaring lions
Devour lives and seize treasure
Priests profane my law
Officials like wolves tearing prey

[Outro]
I searched for one to stand
In the breach on behalf of the land
But I found no one there
So I poured out my indignation
